category_definitions.Policy: government or International Maritime Organization rules, negotiations or decisions on maritime emissions and clean shipping

category_definitions.Industry: shipping company strategy, commercial commitments, fleet investment or industry-wide clean shipping adoption
category_definitions.Infrastructure: ports, bunkering facilities, fuel supply infrastructure, green corridors or production capacity for sustainable marine fuels
category_definitions.Technology: ship propulsion, engines, retrofits or alternative marine fuel technology and demonstrations
category_definitions.Research: research studies, lifecycle emissions analysis or scientific assessments of shipping decarbonization
category_definitions.Commentary: an opinion column or editorial arguing a position on clean shipping
category_definitions.Events: an upcoming maritime decarbonization conference, forum or public event
category_definitions.Other: other substantive news about environmental impacts of maritime shipping

relevance_definition: substantive news about maritime shipping emissions policy, decarbonization, sustainable marine fuels or clean shipping deployment
exclusion_definition: unrelated news, shipping stock tips, job advertisements or generic logistics and freight reports without maritime decarbonization relevance
